notes: The single English no carries both כָל and the clause's לֹא, so the two share one discontinuous unit under rule 35; the alternative reading is named in that unit's note.
The suffix on דָּמָהּ is not written separately: whereof carries the resumption, and the ASV writes the blood bare.
The partitive מִן keeps any of as one rendering, headed on of, while the article on בַּקֹּדֶשׁ takes the written the and the one on בָּאֵשׁ is unrepresented.
